messages.text: Cold launch feels slow since last week's release. Can you find out why and fix it?
On it. I will profile a cold launch of the release build first, so we fix the real cause and not a guess.

Found it. The thumbnail cache is rebuilt on the main thread at every launch, because the version check compares a string with a number and never matches:

```swift
if cache.version != String(schemaVersion) { rebuild() }   // always true
```

That rebuild is 1.5 s of the 2.1 s launch.
Ouch. Fix it, and add a test so it can't come back.

Done, on `fix/cold-launch`:

- the version is compared as a number
- a rebuild that is really needed now happens off the main thread
- a new test fails if launch ever rebuilds an up-to-date cache

Cold launch is back to 0.58 s, a little better than before the regression.

messages.text: Reproduced on three machines. Cold launch is 2.1 s on 2.4.0 against 0.6 s on 2.3.1, and it does not happen on a warm launch. Steps and timings are in the test plan.
Thanks Mila. Wren is on it. Ivan, can we ship a point release this week if the fix is small?
Yes. The nightly is green, so I can cut 2.4.1 within the hour of the fix merging. I will keep the release branch frozen until then.
Send the pull request my way when it is up. I will look at the threading first.
Approved the settings migration with one note: the fallback path has no test. Not blocking, but worth an hour.
Test plan for 2.4 is done: 46 cases, 44 pass. The two failures are both the slow launch.
CI is 4 minutes faster since I split the UI tests into their own job. Nothing else changed.
